================================================================================
KEY DECISIONS (All 4 Approved ✅)
================================================================================

Q1: AUGMENT vs. Replace vs. Parallel?
    ✅ APPROVED: AUGMENT
    Reason: Preserves Phase 4; maintains fallback; fast time-to-value

Q2: Timeline — Phase 5A?
    ✅ APPROVED: Phase 5A (parallel to Phase 5)
    Reason: Doesn't block portable agents; leverages Phase 4 output

Q3: MVP Scope?
    ✅ APPROVED: FULL (patch + minor + major with tiered gates)
    Reason: Full flexibility with approval gates scaled to risk

Q4: Long-term Strategy?
    ✅ APPROVED: Both indefinitely (portable agents + agentic coexist)
    Reason: Different jobs; portable for CI/CD, agentic for interactive

================================================================================
DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS
================================================================================

10 MAJOR DESIGN DECISIONS
✅ Decision 1: AUGMENT (wrap shell scripts)
✅ Decision 2: Control plane only (Phase 5A); multi-repo later
✅ Decision 3: FULL scope (patch/minor/major)
✅ Decision 4: Multi-engine support (Copilot + Claude)
✅ Decision 5: Call Phase 4 unchanged (no modifications)
✅ Decision 6: Fail-fast + suggest fixes (LLM strength)
✅ Decision 7: 7-layer safety gates (defense in depth)
✅ Decision 8: Full dry-run support (preview mode)
✅ Decision 9: Audit logging (decisions + redact secrets)
✅ Decision 10: Tiered approval flows (scope-based)

7 SAFETY GATES
✅ Gate 1: Pre-flight checks (branch, state, files)
✅ Gate 2: Agentic reasoning (confidence score ≥ 0.8)
✅ Gate 3: Changelog validation (schema + entries)
✅ Gate 4: Version validation (semver rules)
✅ Gate 5: Authorization (maintainers team)
✅ Gate 6: Approval gates (patch auto / minor review / major 2+)
✅ Gate 7: Integrity filter (GitHub safe-outputs)

TIERED APPROVAL FLOWS
✅ PATCH: Auto-approve if all gates pass
✅ MINOR: Require 1 human review
✅ MAJOR: Require 2+ maintainer approvals
